business_operations.headline: Building Systems. Leading Teams. Staying to Scale Them.
business_operations.cover_letter:
I'm not looking for the exit. I'm looking for the escalator.

For 10+ years, I've taken messy, manual operations—data entry, compliance workflows, multi-jurisdictional permitting—and turned them into reliable, auditable systems. I've supervised teams, built SOPs that became department standards, and maintained 99%+ accuracy on high-volume legal filings.

My next chapter: **Data Moderator → Chat Customer Service → Chat Moderator → Chat Developer**. That's not a sprint. That's a 5-10 year commitment to understand your data loop, master it, and build the modern systems that scale it.

With my CSEP credential, I bring not just operations expertise—I bring a permanent performance upgrade. I'm here to stay and deliver compounding value.

CERS, Accela, LAFD, multi-jurisdictional regulatory navigation, audit-ready documentation
Supervised 15+ staff across regional locations, built training programs, maintained 99%+ accuracy

current.description: Master the 30/60/90: Days 1-30 (learn the SOP), Days 31-60 (spot inefficiencies), Days 61-90 (pitch the upgrade). This is ground-level expertise.

progression.description: Move from backend operations to front-line customer interaction. Understand the human loop, not just the workflow.
Quality control and content governance. Apply operations discipline to customer experience. Spot patterns, enforce consistency, scale culture.
Bridge the gap. Automate the moderation layer with the same rigor I've applied to legal operations. Build modern systems for a modern department.

business_operations.csep_value: My CSEP credential isn't a bridge to leave operations—it's a lever to upgrade how we execute it. Combined with 10+ years of hands-on operations, it signals that I'm not a job-hopper. I'm a builder who understands both the business rules and the technical constraints, and I'm committed to fixing what breaks at scale.
